fault: The random seed was changed from 7 to 42 without being reported.
The task was run with 20 trials per participant instead of the preregistered 30.
The accuracy criterion for continuing to the equivalence test was relaxed from 0.8 to 0.7 in both branches.
The pass threshold was lowered to 0.7 but the 'below criterion' branch still uses 0.8, so accuracies between 0.7 and 0.8 go both ways.
The equivalence margin was widened from +/-0.1 to +/-0.3, making equivalence easier to claim.
The equivalence test (TOST) was replaced by an ordinary independent-samples t-test while the step is still described as testing equivalence.
Accuracy was dropped from the summarised measures so only response time is analysed, although the accuracy criterion still gates the analysis.
The per-subject summary step was skipped, so the accuracy check and the test run directly on raw trial data.
An undisclosed age limit was added to the eligibility condition on top of consent.
Per-subject accuracy was aggregated with a sum instead of a mean, so it reports correct counts rather than proportions.
Correctness was recorded as a string instead of a boolean, so accuracy cannot be computed as a proportion.
Participants whose task failed are routed to the 'Completed' end, so dropouts are counted as completers and the discontinued count is lost.
